description: Reception Capacity in the National Distribution Network (RND) is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). This dataset represents the geographic location of the HV/MV substations, with the geographic area of influence of MV lines and the available hosting capacity for power generation in the Distribution Grid quarterly update as well as the forecast values. Coverage: Portugal. The portal files it under Electrical Network. The portal shows 2026-07-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
